notes: Step 1 parts were correct; no parts added or dropped.
Arduino UNO WiFi Rev2 is not in the catalogue and lookup_part found nothing, so it is defined as a new part type with Uno-style header ports.

Circuit read from the image: pin 2 -> green wire -> breadboard column 3 -> 220 ohm resistor (column 3 to column 6) -> LED anode (column 6, the bent/longer leg) -> LED cathode (column 8) -> black wire in column 8 -> GND next to AREF on the digital header.

Breadboard hole names follow the catalogue: rows f-j are bank 'b'. The image shows rows j-f in the top half, so the LED legs are at row i, the resistor at row h, and the wire ends at rows g (green) and h (black).
The LED anode is assumed to be the bent (longer) leg, which is the one connected to the resistor.
The sketch also reads analog pin A1 but no sensor is connected to it, so A1 is left unconnected.
